short_description: Saint-Gobain Sun Ban SGG Sapphire Blue 5 mm pyrolytic solar-control glass. VLT 22.9%, SHGC 0.39, U-value 5.72 W/m²K. Sold per sqft, cut to size.
long_description:
## What it is

Saint-Gobain Sun Ban SGG Sapphire Blue is a 5 mm solar-control glass from Saint-Gobain's Sun Ban range for residences. A pyrolytic coating is fired onto clear soda-lime float glass on the float line itself, so the coating is a hard coat, and the pane reads as a reflective blue from outside. It is supplied as a single monolithic pane, annealed, so it is not a safety glass as delivered; a processor can toughen or laminate it to IS 2553 Part 1 if a door, railing or large opening calls for it. Weight is about 12.5 kg per square metre, so a 1200 × 1800 mm pane weighs roughly 27 kg.

## What it's for

Windows and residential glazing: sliding and casement windows, balconies, staircase glazing and small façades on houses and apartments in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, where the need is to cut afternoon heat without losing the view. It is suitable for exterior use. As supplied — annealed and monolithic — it is not intended for overhead glazing.

## Key specifications

At 5 mm, visible light transmission is 22.9% with 23.7% external reflection, which gives strong glare control and daytime privacy. The solar heat gain coefficient is 0.39, so a little under 40% of incident solar energy reaches the room, and the U-value is 5.72 W/m²K. UV transmission is in the region of 15% and sound reduction about 30 dB for the single pane. Thermal-shock resistance is the usual 40 °C of annealed glass and bending strength 41 MPa. The substrate is IS 14900 transparent float glass; IS 2553 Part 1 applies only once the pane is toughened or laminated, and IS 16231 only if it is built into a DGU.

## Installation notes

Install with the coated face towards the interior (surface 2) — Saint-Gobain states this protects the coating from weathering and keeps reflectivity consistent. Keep at least 12 mm of edge engagement in the frame, use setting blocks and a neutral-cure silicone or EPDM gasket in uPVC, aluminium or timber frames. The hard coat is cuttable, so panes can be cut and arrised at the dealer or on site, but edges should be clean-cut to limit thermal-stress breakage on sunny elevations. Clean with water and a mild detergent only; no abrasive pads on the coated face.

## What's supplied

Cut-to-size panes with as-cut edges, interleaved with paper or cork pads and delivered on an A-frame or in a wooden crate. Minimum order 10 sqft; typical lead time about 5 days from Hyderabad and Vijayawada stockists. Warranty is recorded as 120 months on the coating, to be confirmed on the dealer invoice. HSN 7005, GST 18%.
